observations.text: Official rule: activating PEL-54 converts BEX-81 into its active form.
When active BEX-81 is present, it produces BIR-24.
When BIR-24 encounters LUM-82, the validated terminal code becomes JOT-75.
Official revision: for the chain involving BIR-24 and LUM-82, the accepted terminal code is JOT-75; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with LUM-82 is JOT-61.
Official rule: activating MUR-98 converts ZIR-61 into its active form.
When active ZIR-61 is present, it produces XAN-22.
When XAN-22 encounters CYN-39, the validated terminal code becomes GOL-66.
Official revision: for the chain involving XAN-22 and CYN-39, the accepted terminal code is GOL-66; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with CYN-39 is GOL-81.
Official rule: activating MUR-54 converts XAN-40 into its active form.
When active XAN-40 is present, it produces MUR-71.
When MUR-71 encounters ZIR-36, the validated terminal code becomes TEK-11.
Official revision: for the chain involving MUR-71 and ZIR-36, the accepted terminal code is TEK-11; lower-authority alternatives are superseded.
Unverified rumor claims the terminal code associated with ZIR-36 is LOQ-26.
